rationale: The short thesis is intact — price is still ~3.7% below session VWAP on 2.67x relative volume with the 152.50 shelf capping rallies, and the bounce off 151.37 is on fading volume (87k→57k→48k), consistent with a flag rather than a bottom; the adverse excursion is well under one 5-min ATR and the 152.05 invalidation caps remaining risk at roughly $42 versus a ~$66 path to the 150.41 retest. The main caution is the firm bid at 151.81 above last and a +0.96% tape, which raises late-day squeeze risk, so a reclaim of 152 exits the trade rather than averaging into strength. Flipping long against all-day distribution on one weak bounce lacks the evidentiary edge to justify crossing the spread twice.
